content.text:
Read-only audit complete; no files changed. The four focused suites pass: 20 tests, 0 failures.

1. Runtime data flow

- Web startup calls `initPostHog()` and conditionally wraps the app in `PostHogProvider`; without a project token or with the kill switch enabled, no client initializes ([main-react.tsx:22](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/main-react.tsx:22), [posthog.ts:24](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/posthog.ts:24)).
- Each Pi Agent gets a dedicated `subscribeAgentAnalytics()` subscription. Agent lifecycle events become content-free PostHog events: `agent_turn_started`, `$ai_generation`, `tool_invocation_started`, `tool_invoked`, `agent_turn_completed`, and optionally `agent_turn_failed` ([useKeatingAgent.tsx:834](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/hooks/useKeatingAgent.tsx:834), [agent-analytics.ts:293](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/agent-analytics.ts:293)).
- `$ai_generation` carries trace/span/session IDs, model/provider, latency, TTFT, stop reason, token usage, and provider-reported cost. Prompts, completions, tool arguments/results, and raw errors are deliberately omitted ([agent-analytics.ts:247](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/agent-analytics.ts:247)).
- All captures pass through `before_send: sanitizePostHogEvent`, then go same-origin to `/ingest`; Vite proxies development traffic and Nitro proxies production traffic to PostHog’s US endpoints ([posthog.ts:34](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/posthog.ts:34), [nitro.config.ts:33](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/nitro.config.ts:33)).
- The parallel `recordAgentEvent()` path is not PostHog. It projects agent events into a canonical local conversation runtime and localStorage-backed event store; durable projection strips tool arguments, progress, and results ([useKeatingAgent.tsx:862](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/hooks/useKeatingAgent.tsx:862), [agent-events.ts:48](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/integration/agent-events.ts:48), [storage-adapter.ts:33](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/event-store/storage-adapter.ts:33)).
- Evaluation signals are split:

  - Explicit response feedback sends only `signal`, `has_comment`, and `session_id` to PostHog, while topic, comment, message referent, and response content remain in IndexedDB ([useKeatingAgent.tsx:332](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/hooks/useKeatingAgent.tsx:332), [storage.ts:1025](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/storage.ts:1025)).
  - Quiz analytics send structural counts, numeric score, partial credit, and duration; question/topic/answers remain local ([QuizRenderer.tsx:1119](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/QuizRenderer.tsx:1119), [QuizRenderer.tsx:1289](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/QuizRenderer.tsx:1289)).
  - Local reward construction joins full session turns to explicit feedback, inferred next-turn signals, and quiz outcomes, but none of the resulting `RewardedTurn` score/provenance is exported to PostHog ([reward.ts:154](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/reward.ts:154)).
  - `evaluate_teaching` invokes local `prompt_eval` or `bench`; `bench` saves its score/report/trace locally. PostHog sees only generic tool lifecycle plus `artifact_created`, not the evaluation score, hypothesis, objectives, or scorer provenance ([improvement.ts:375](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/browser-tools/improvement.ts:375), [assessment.ts:48](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/browser-tools/assessment.ts:48), [useKeatingAgent.tsx:101](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/hooks/useKeatingAgent.tsx:101)).
  - KeatingBench sends only aggregate page/export counts, while scoring over session content happens locally ([KeatingBench.tsx:210](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/pages/KeatingBench.tsx:210), [KeatingBench.tsx:697](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/pages/KeatingBench.tsx:697)).

2. Main exported seams

- Telemetry: `subscribeAgentAnalytics`, `AgentAnalyticsOptions`, `AgentAnalyticsCapture`, `AgentAnalyticsProperties` ([agent-analytics.ts:10](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/agent-analytics.ts:10), [agent-analytics.ts:176](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/agent-analytics.ts:176)).
- PostHog lifecycle: `ANALYTICS_SCHEMA_VERSION`, `postHogGlobalProperties`, `isPostHogEnabled`, `isSessionReplayAvailable`, `initPostHog`, `updateAnalyticsPreferences`, `posthog` ([posthog.ts:9](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/posthog.ts:9)).
- Privacy/preferences: `analyticsPath`, `analyticsUrl`, `sanitizeAnalyticsProperties`, `sanitizePostHogEvent`, `sanitizeReplayRequest`; `default/read/write/parseAnalyticsPreferences` ([analytics-privacy.ts:37](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/analytics-privacy.ts:37), [analytics-preferences.ts:8](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/analytics-preferences.ts:8)).
- Local evaluation: `createOutcomeCollector`, `createAssessmentTools`; `computeSessionRewardedTurns`, `applyJudgeScores`, `buildKtoExamples`, `buildPreferencePairs`; `recordFeedback`, `recordQuestionCheck` ([assessment.ts:27](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/browser-tools/assessment.ts:27), [reward.ts:154](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/reward.ts:154), [reward.ts:331](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/reward.ts:331)).

3. Consent, privacy, and redaction

- Analytics are opt-out, not prior-consent: default `captureEnabled` is `true`. Replay defaults on whenever the deployment build flag makes replay available; malformed preference storage also falls back to enabled ([analytics-preferences.ts:8](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/analytics-preferences.ts:8), [analytics-preferences.ts:35](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/analytics-preferences.ts:35)).
- Settings persist opt-out locally, call PostHog opt-in/opt-out APIs, and gate replay behind both capture consent and the deploy flag ([posthog.ts:75](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/posthog.ts:75), [KeatingUiSettingsTab.tsx:506](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/KeatingUiSettingsTab.tsx:506)).
- DNT is respected. Replay masks all text, inputs, and attributes; disables console capture; strips network bodies/headers and dynamic URL identifiers ([posthog.ts:38](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/posthog.ts:38)).
- Custom-property redaction removes known top-level content/error keys and sanitizes URLs; exception values are replaced while stack structure remains ([analytics-privacy.ts:8](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/analytics-privacy.ts:8), [analytics-privacy.ts:58](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/analytics-privacy.ts:58)).
- No `identify()` or `reset()` calls exist. The operating contract explicitly keeps visitors anonymous and treats learning-session IDs only as correlation IDs ([posthog-operating-plan.md:18](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/analytics/posthog-operating-plan.md:18)).

4. Focused test intent and result

- `agent-analytics.test.ts`: streamed latency/TTFT/usage/cost, multi-generation tool loops, error classification, cancellation, empty responses, retries, cleanup, and absence of private payloads ([agent-analytics.test.ts:130](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/test/agent-analytics.test.ts:130)).
- `analytics-privacy.test.ts`: dynamic-route/query redaction, content-key removal, exception sanitization, immutable capture transforms, replay request stripping ([analytics-privacy.test.ts:10](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/test/analytics-privacy.test.ts:10)).
- `analytics-preferences.test.ts`: default behavior, persisted opt-out, deploy-time replay gate, malformed-storage fallback ([analytics-preferences.test.ts:7](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/test/analytics-preferences.test.ts:7)).
- `integration/agent-events.test.ts`: canonical runtime completion/error/cancellation classification without persisting assistant/error content ([agent-events.test.ts:32](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/test/integration/agent-events.test.ts:32)).
- Command passed: `rtk bun test src/test/agent-analytics.test.ts src/test/analytics-preferences.test.ts src/test/analytics-privacy.test.ts src/test/integration/agent-events.test.ts` — 20 pass, 0 fail.

5. Arize integration gaps and risks

- There is no Arize/Phoenix/OpenInference implementation. OpenTelemetry API appears only transitively; there is no SDK/exporter or server ingestion route.
- Browser-side Arize credentials would be unacceptable. Export must go through a server-only same-origin endpoint/collector with failure isolation, batching, retry bounds, and a kill switch.
- `subscribeAgentAnalytics` is already transport-neutral and is the best initial seam, but dozens of feature/eval captures remain directly coupled to `posthog.capture`. Introduce one typed telemetry/evaluation dispatcher rather than adding a second parallel subscription and duplicated component calls.
- Rich evaluation content is intentionally local. Arize evaluations requiring prompts/responses cannot work from current telemetry. The design must explicitly choose between content-free observability and a separate, informed-consent, redacted evaluation-upload mode.
- Correlation is insufficient: feedback has only `session_id`; quizzes have no session/turn/trace ID; benchmark outputs have none; `run_id` is created only at `agent_start`. Create a stable turn/evaluation ID before send and propagate it through generation, tool, feedback, quiz, comparison, and evaluator records.
- No first-class evaluation schema exists for `evaluation_name`, score/label, scorer kind/version, explanation policy, dataset/example ID, prompt/policy version, synthetic-vs-real source, or model configuration. Current benchmark artifacts and PostHog behavioral events cannot be interpreted safely as Arize evals without this layer.
- The sanitizer is a shallow denylist. Nested content under a newly introduced property could escape it. Arize export should use strict per-event allowlists and recursive size/redaction enforcement.
- The model field uses `message.model`, ignoring `responseModel`; resolved provider model versions may be misattributed ([agent-analytics.ts:116](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/agent-analytics.ts:116)).
- `source` currently collapses every non-browser path to `"provider"`, losing BYOK versus hosted/provider-owned distinctions important for cost, privacy, and reliability attribution ([useKeatingAgent.tsx:840](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/hooks/useKeatingAgent.tsx:840)).
- Failed runs emit both `agent_turn_completed` and `agent_turn_failed`; Arize ingestion must avoid double-counting outcomes ([agent-analytics.ts:406](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/agent-analytics.ts:406)).
- The operating plan and setup report have drifted from code: current events such as `agent_turn_failed`, `tool_invocation_started`, and KeatingBench events are absent, while the setup report still describes an older nine-event integration ([posthog-setup-report.md:3](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/posthog-setup-report.md:3)).
- Unit tests do not prove browser initialization, opt-out behavior against the real SDK, production proxying, payloads in PostHog Live Events, or replay masking. The operating plan itself requires those runtime gates ([posthog-operating-plan.md:180](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/analytics/posthog-operating-plan.md:180)).
- The work is currently uncommitted: core telemetry/privacy files, docs, source-map support, and tests are dirty/untracked. Arize work should begin only after this PostHog baseline is stabilized or explicitly preserve it as protected concurrent work.

No live PostHog project query was performed, so this audit confirms repository behavior and tests, not deployed ingestion or dashboard state.
